structural_breaks.note: Ind AS adoption (transition date 2016-04-01). FY2016Q4-FY2017Q4 points are Indian GAAP (revenue net of excise); FY2018+ statements carry Ind AS restated FY2017 comparatives (gross of excise, e.g. Apr-Jun 2016 14,887 lakh vs IGAAP 13,027). Each point's prior_year_comparative is from its own statement, so YoY within a point is same-basis except where flagged.
GST: Ind AS revenue up to 2017-06-30 includes excise duty; from 2017-07-01 net of GST (note 3 of the Mar-2018 statement). YoY for FY2018Q2-FY2019Q1 not like-for-like (flagged in pyc_basis).
From the Mar-2017 statement, segment revenue includes other operating income; earlier IGAAP segment revenue = net sales only (small, ~0.5-1% of segment).
Presentation unit changed from INR lakh to INR crore (no scope change; comparatives re-expressed). All values converted to INR million.

profile.products: Power Systems: power & distribution transformers (first 400 kV transformer designed/built/commissioned in FY2025-26; ester-oil transformers), turnkey EPC for electrical sub-stations (targeting 400 kV projects), maintenance products. Industrial Systems (not target): LV/MV electric motors, traction motors, drives & automation, magnet technology (elevator) machines. Source: AR 2025-26 letter from ED (p.4-5), segment definitions in every Reg.33 statement.

plants.city: Airoli, Navi Mumbai (MIDC Thane-Belapur Road, Maharashtra)
plants.products: transformers (power/distribution, up to 400 kV class), motors, drives — single plant location stated in AR; large transformer capacity expansion under way (AR p.4)

profile.end_markets: Domestic Indian utilities (state transmission/distribution), industrial & infrastructure EPCs, railways; exports only 0.84% of turnover in FY2025-26 (BRSR, AR p.69) to 7 countries.

인도 자본재 생산 — 변전·산업 설비투자 사이클

Every quarter cross-checked: Power Systems + Industrial Systems = total segment revenue = P&L revenue; value vs later statements' comparative columns. Sep-2022 segment page text layer prints 32365 but the P&L line and segment sum give 32355 (used).
FY2016Q4-FY2017Q4 and FY2018Q1-Q3 statements are scanned images; values read visually and cross-checked (e.g. 9M/annual totals).
FY2021Q1 (Apr-Jun 2020) collapse (Power Systems 3,788 lakh) reflects the national COVID-19 lockdown; the validator 3x-change warning for FY2021Q1 is expected, not a unit error.
